title: Cash register
closedHint: Count the opening float, then open the register to start selling.

open.title: Open the register
open.hint: Enter the money in the drawer before the first sale.
open.submit: Open the register with this float

report.intact: Receipts and action log checked: nothing was changed.
report.broken: The action log or the receipts were changed. Stop selling on this PC and contact DZBuild support.
report.blind: Blind close: the drawer amounts are not shown. Count the drawer; the variance is worked out at the close.

close.title: Close the register
close.hint: Count all the money in the drawer, note by note. The Z report can no longer be changed.
close.recount: The difference is above the allowed limit. Count the drawer again, note by note.
close.backupFailed: The register is closed, but the automatic backup failed. Make a backup from Settings › Backups.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.fromTill: Paid with money from the drawer
expenses.fromTillHint: The money leaves this terminal's drawer and shows on the Z report.
expenses.tillClosed: The register is closed: the expense is paid outside the drawer.
expenses.dayHint: A day of the current year, today at the latest.
expenses.empty: No expenses in this period. Record one with “New expense”.
expenses.reverseBody: The {{amount}} expense ({{category}}) stays in the history: a negative entry of the same amount cancels it.
expenses.reverseTill: The money does not go back into the drawer: record a cash in if it does.
